# AI Engineer

## About Us
WOGOM is a B2B Commerce and Retail Enablement Platform, empowering 6,000+ retailers and 450+ sellers across India with better Products, Pricing, Credit, and Growth Opportunities. Our goal is to build a connected ecosystem where technology, capital, and commerce converge to help Indian retailers scale with confidence.

## Role Overview
The AI Engineer will play a crucial role in developing and deploying AI models that drive real business impact, leveraging machine learning and deep learning fundamentals to solve complex problems. This role will have a direct impact on WOGOM's mission by enabling Indian retailers to scale with confidence through technology, pricing, credit, and growth opportunities. The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical expertise, business acumen, and collaboration skills to drive real-world AI implementation.

## Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models to drive business impact, working closely with cross-functional teams to integrate models into production systems.
• Collaborate with teams to understand requirements and deploy AI models, ensuring seamless integration and minimal disruption.
• Monitor and improve model performance, analyzing data to optimize results and drive continuous learning.
• Document workflows, models, and technical decisions to share knowledge and ensure transparency.
• Train and optimize models using structured and unstructured data, developing data processing pipelines to support model development.
• Integrate AI models into production systems and internal tools, ensuring successful deployment and collaboration with engineering and product teams.

## Requirements
### Must-Have Skills
• Strong machine learning and deep learning fundamentals, with proficiency in Python programming and experience in model deployment and real-world AI implementation.
• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data, with a strong understanding of AI model development and deployment.
• Proficiency in developing and implementing Python-based solutions to support AI model development and deployment.
• Experience with data processing and analysis pipelines to support model development and optimization.

### Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, with knowledge of SQL and data analysis to optimize model performance.
• Familiarity with APIs and backend integration to integrate AI models into production systems.
• Strong understanding of data analysis pipelines to support model development and optimization.

## Who Will Succeed in This Role
The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, strategic thinker who is passionate about AI and machine learning, with excellent communication and problem-solving skills. They will be a team player who can effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with a focus on continuous learning and improvement.

## Success Metrics
• Within the first 30 days, develop a thorough understanding of the company's AI landscape and existing models, and establish relationships with key stakeholders and team members.
• Within the first 90 days, deploy at least one AI model into production, and develop a roadmap for future AI model development and deployment.
• Within the first 6 months, achieve significant business impact through AI model deployment, and establish themselves as a subject matter expert in AI engineering.

## How to Apply
To apply for this role, please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your experience and qualifications. We look forward to hearing from you and exploring how you can contribute to WOGOM's mission to empower Indian retailers and sellers through technology, pricing, credit, and growth opportunities.
